description: Publish a watch-face design (a `wff-watchface` catalog design) to Wear OS watches, or take it off them. `published: true` publishes the design's current revision: the server exports its Watch Face Format, builds a signed Watch Face Push APK, and lists it to every watch linked to the owner's account (and, for a public design, to any watch). Publish again after editing to ship the edit; the `version` moves only when the face itself changed. `published: false` stops listing it. Only the design's owner may. A face the packager refuses is refused here with its diagnostics. A public design is listed to every watch on its own, from a settled revision; publishing pins the revision, and `visibility: private` keeps a public design to the owner's linked watches only; run ui_builder_validate_watch_face first, which says per check what to fix and how much of the memory budget the face uses.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

published.description: true to publish the current revision, false to unpublish.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

visibility.description: With published: true. public lists it to every watch (the design must be public); private only to the owner's linked watches. Omit to follow the design's own visibility.

name: ui_builder_publish_watch_face
